cheats.name: Infinite health
cheats.description: Mario's health is refilled every logic frame and health loss is ignored, including instant-death paths.

cheats.name: Infinite FLUDD water
cheats.description: FLUDD refills to its maximum every logic frame.

cheats.name: Infinite lives
cheats.description: The lives counter is kept at 99.

cheats.name: Max coins
cheats.description: The coin counter is kept at 99. Each pickup passes 100 for one tick, which also grants the 1-up.

cheats.name: Unlock all nozzles
cheats.description: Sets the nozzle-unlocked flag for every stage. Runs once, then switches itself off.
